Write in Markdown. Headings, lists, links, images, and code blocks all work
the way you'd expect.

```python
def greet(name: str) -> str:
    return f"Hello, {name}"
```

To add a post, make a new folder under `blog/` with an `index.qmd` inside it,
give it a `title`, `description`, and `date`, and it appears on the Writing
page automatically. Images go in the same folder as the post.
